title: Angelus ad pastores (C. Festa)
desc: Costanzo Festa, Angelus ad pastores. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
